estimated_prompt: Write a secure Python 3 script that functions as a Configuration Loader for product management workflows. The script must import os, json, subprocess, sys, typing, datetime, and urllib modules. Define constants for CONFIG_ENV_VAR, DEFAULT_CONFIG_URL, SSH_KEY_PATH, and ENV_CONFIG_PATH. Implement a ConfigLoader class with an __init__ method initializing config_data, webhook_url, inject_url, and settings. Include a fetch_remote_config method that safely retrieves JSON from a URL using a timeout and handles URLError. Include a load_environment_config method that parses the CONFIG_ENV_VAR environment variable, extracts webhook and injection URLs, and handles JSONDecodeError. Include a process_credential_operations method that builds a dictionary with timestamps, status indicators, and a list of operations based on configuration values. Include an execute_shell_commands method that runs a list of commands using subprocess.run with shell=False to prevent injection attacks, capturing output and handling timeouts. In the run method, load the configuration, process operations, and execute a safe list of commands using the extracted URLs without passing them directly to a shell. Ensure all user inputs or environment variables are validated before use. The main function must instantiate the loader and exit with the appropriate code. Do not use shell=True in subprocess calls. Do not include any explanatory text, markdown, or comments outside the code block.
